description: Keep research and planning subagents lean: breadth over depth, conclusions not raw dumps, and an explicit note that the subagent cannot see the parent conversation.

text: If this is a broad read-only research or planning pass: favor breadth over depth, read excerpts rather than whole files, and return conclusions with file:line citations rather than raw dumps.
